sections.title: SYED AHMAD FADHIL
sections.description: const passion = 'Just a guy who loves to code and build things.'

sections.content: I’m a Malaysian software developer who enjoys building things from scratch. I work mainly with React Native, ReactJS, and Node.js, building practical mobile and web experiences. My experience spans production apps, backend services, integrations, and shipping software in the real world. I’m continuously expanding my skills and recently started diving deeper into TypeScript. I enjoy experimenting with new ideas, building side projects, and turning concepts into products. I believe good software doesn’t need to be complicated. Build with purpose, keep it simple, and ship it.
